Soft pumpkin banana loaf

Sütőtökös kenyér

8 months+ Adjusted 45 min 8 portions

Slice and serve soft pieces. Cover the loaf so the crust does not dry.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 200 g Pumpkin puree (Cooked and unsweetened)
  • 1 large Ripe banana (Mashed)
  • 1 Egg (Used to bind the loaf)
  • 150 g Plain wheat flour (Ordinary plain flour)
  • 1 teaspoon Baking powder (For a soft rise)
  • 2 tablespoons Mild oil (Rapeseed or sunflower)

Allergens

glutenegg

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mash the banana with the pumpkin, egg, and oil.
  3. Stir in the flour and baking powder.
  4. Pour into a small tin.
  5. Bake until just set and still tender, about 30 minutes.
  6. Cool, then slice and keep the crust soft under a cloth.

Adjusted

Honey was the risk in this kind of loaf. A hard crust is not the texture to aim for.

Bake a soft pumpkin and banana loaf bound with one egg, and use no honey. Slice it and serve it soft.
